headline: US Refiners Squeeze Gasoline Margins Despite Output Cuts, EIA Data Show
summary: U.S. refiners kept gasoline yields below 45% during the first eight months of the year to chase diesel and jet fuel margins, yet still produced enough supply to virtually wipe out gasoline margins.
why: Refinery yield adjustments and fuel crack spreads directly dictate profitability for downstream energy producers and reflect broader shifts in transport fuel consumption.

impacts.name: RBOB Gasoline
impacts.why: Persistent gasoline output despite lower refinery yields has depressed refining margins for the fuel.
